name: Majokko a la Mode
original_name: 魔女っ娘ア・ラ・モード
source: In the Mint Kingdom, there's a magic school called "Twinkle Academy". There, an exam is held in the summer that the students take to test their magical habilities. However, this year the exam will be taken in pairs... and you need a partner! You need to pursue one of the six heroines so you can do the exam... and maybe something else!
translation: 薄荷王国有一所名为“Twinkle Academy”的魔法学校。每年夏天，学校都会举行考试，检验学生的魔法能力。然而今年的考试需要两人组队…你必须找到一名搭档！你需要在六位女主角中追求一人，与她共同参加考试…也许还会发生其他事情！
